name: orchestrate-skill
description: Prepare each run (interview, tool inventory, install proposals), then select and run bounded multi-agent strategies with durable artifacts, explicit models, typed review gates, and safe recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-agent strategy selection, dispatch, and gates
interface.longDescription: Prepare the run — interview the user when the request is unclear, inventory installed skills and CLIs, propose missing tools — then choose and execute staged, parallel, hierarchical, team, workflow, loop, advisor, adversarial, or external-CLI agent strategies with durable state and review gates. Concurrency is the default; research runs as parallel source lanes.
defaultPrompt: Use $orchestrate to execute this implementation plan.
Use $orchestrate to fan these independent tasks out safely.
Use $orchestrate to deep-research this question across GitHub, X, YouTube and the web.
